thread:
Sam (Support): FYI we just got hit with a dunning escalation from AcmeCorp. Their account got suspended and they say all API calls return 403. They claim card decline + PO requirement. Need advice on next steps.

Aline (Customer): Hi team — our procurement flagged the invoice and we can't provide a card. We require PO #PO-9987 before payment. Also asking about VAT reversal; we are EU-registered. Service suspended immediately which broke our integration.

Jess (Billing): Copy. Can you paste the invoice id and the decline code? I can check payment gateway logs and whether we can accept PO + net-30 instead of card.

Aline (Customer): Invoice: INV-2026-0412, Amount: EUR 48,200. Decline note: 3DS required / card expired on file. We tried to update, then got "card declined - insufficient authentication."

Sam (Support): Repro note from customer: after suspension they see: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "account_suspended", "message": "billing overdue" }
```
They say it broke realtime webhooks.

Viktor (CS): Ouch. Two things: (1) PO requirement is legitimate for them — we accept signed PO documents for Dedicated/Enterprise customers. (2) For EU VAT handling, we need their VAT ID to zero-rate VAT if they're registered outside our billing country. Marta, any red flags on accepting a PO retroactively and reinstating service?

Marta (Legal): We can accept PO as purchase condition if it's matched to our master services agreement. Need signature + PO referencing the MSA and the invoice number. If they want tax-exempt treatment, they must provide a valid EU VAT number and we need to confirm VIES lookup. We can't backdate tax treatment without docs.

Jess (Billing): From gateway logs: capture attempt failed with code 4019 - authentication_required (3DS). The stored card token is expired. We can issue a manual payment link (Stripe hosted invoice) or accept a wire transfer with BOL. If they send a signed PO and wire, we can process and then decide on reinstatement.

Sam (Support): Customer asks for immediate reinstatement once PO is submitted — is that allowed? They say it's blocking production.

Marta (Legal): We can do conditional reinstatement on receipt of a valid PO referencing INV-2026-0412 plus a cleared payment OR a signed statement acknowledging liability with payment within X days. For enterprise, common to reinstate on signed PO + administrator approval, but Collections must flag risk.

CollectionsBot: Policy: standard workflow = suspend after 14 days overdue. Reinstatement options: (a) full payment, (b) signed PO + partial deposit >=25%, (c) collections review for credit hold removal.

Jess (Billing): Suggested steps: 
1) Ask Acme to upload scanned PO referencing INV-2026-0412 and MSA.
2) Provide payment options (stripe link / wire instructions).
3) If they need VAT-exempt, request VAT ID and org docs.
4) Collections to mark account pending PO and evaluate risk for temporary reenable.

Aline (Customer): We can provide PO immediately but wire transfer needs 3-5 business days. We need a short-term access — can you unblock just the webhook endpoints for 24 hours? We only need read access to hit logs.

Viktor (CS): We cannot partially unblock without ops signoff. Also security risks. Ops (Engineering) — can you do a scoped, read-only token or emergency un-suspend for 24h?

Ops (Engineering): We can create a temporary read-only API key and limit to IPs from AcmeCorp, but needs approval from Finance + Legal. It takes ~30 mins to issue.

Sam (Support): I'll coordinate: ask Acme for PO upload + VAT ID, offer wire + stripe link (include payment note to include invoice number). Offer temporary read-only key upon receipt of PO AND an emailed acknowledgement that they accept billing terms and will wire payment. 

Jess (Billing): I'll prepare a payment link and wire instructions now. Also tagging Collections to schedule a review for credit risk if wire is delayed. Collections, please set timeout 72 hours for follow-up.

CollectionsBot: Action logged: case# COL-2026-782 created, follow-up in 72h.

Marta (Legal): Note: if PO is submitted but doesn't match the MSA terms we must escalate. Sam, ask them to reference the MSA section and sign or else we revert to standard invoicing.

Aline (Customer): Sending PO in 15 min. Thanks — we appreciate temporary access.

Jess (Billing): Payment link: https://pay.redwood.example/inv/INV-2026-0412 (one-time). Wire details sent via direct DM to Aline.

Sam (Support): I'll request PO upload to our billing portal and confirm VAT ID. Once Jess confirms PO & partial payment or wire initiation, Ops to issue read-only key.

Viktor (CS): Keep collection notes terse. If wire doesn't arrive in 72h Collections should reapply suspension. Also loop in account exec if risk >50k.

Aline (Customer): PO uploaded (attached in portal) — PO-9987 references INV-2026-0412 and signed by procurement. VAT ID: EUX-543210.

Jess (Billing): Got it. Marta: can you quick-verify the PO/MA match? If yes, I'll mark billing as pending and request Ops to provision read-only key.

Marta (Legal): Quick check looks fine — PO references MSA, signatures match. VAT ID format OK, but finance will validate VIES and we will handle VAT according to result.

Ops (Engineering): Ready to provision once Collections & Billing confirm. Please confirm exact scope: read-only keys, IP-restrict to AcmeCorp range?

CollectionsBot: Collections note: pending payment confirmation. Timeout 72h from 1759456789.

Jess (Billing): Confirmed scope for Ops: create API key with read-only permissions for logs/webhooks, restrict to IPs 198.51.100.0/24, TTL 24h. Trigger once payment link shows attempt or wire proof provided.

Sam (Support): Update for thread: customer now has PO uploaded and placed a wire initiation screenshot (txn pending). Billing to mark as "pending-provision" and Ops to issue key on proof of initiation.

Viktor (CS): Good. Keep me posted if wire fails; we escalate to account exec and legal.

Aline (Customer): Wire initiated, screenshot with reference sent. Appreciate the help.

Jess (Billing): Logged payment attempt. Collections: please hold until 72h or until funds clear. If funds don't clear, re-suspend.

CollectionsBot: Noted. Case COL-2026-782 -> status: pending_funds.

Sam (Support): Closing loop here. Will follow up when Ops confirms key issuance. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
